#.label: Gift card routing (preview)
#/items/properties/ranges/items/properti: A name for this range. Must be unique inside the entry.
First digits of the lowest card number in the range, for example 600649.
First digits of the highest card number. Use the same digits as “From” for a single prefix.
Total number of digits on the card, for example 16.
#/items/properties/id.label: Entry
#/items/properties/id.description: A name for this entry, for example “Retain24”. Must be unique on this page.
#/items/properties/connector.label: Gift card provider
#/items/properties/connector.description: Who handles gift cards in the ranges below. NONE: Hii Connect does not handle them. Ranges must not overlap: the portal does not check this, and an overlap can send a card to the wrong provider.
#/items/properties/ranges.label: Card number ranges
#/items/properties/ranges.description: The card numbers this provider handles, by the first digits and the length of the card number.
